facts.text: I read every paper and the society pages on the boat. Good deals start on the ferry.
facts.why: Tess says she read the Post and turned to the society page, where she found Trask's daughter and the wedding lead. She commutes on the Staten Island Ferry, so the signed note is true to her.
facts.fix: Good deals start on the ferry. Mine got pitched at a wedding, uninvited.
